notes.title: We made a new game - 48h left! ⌛️
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36422902/05b2d3476516dc21799b8d1d157f8fad4bbe8140.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone 👋 ![/h1]

After months without new games we are back with a cute new game called Little Rooms, it's a [b]Hidden Object Game 🔍[/b], HOG for experts, featuring 36 cozy and beautiful little levels with 4 (maybe 5) game modes!

[b]The game is currently -25% but only for the next 48hours! 
Check the page before it's too late :)[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217260/Little_Rooms/?curator_clanid=36422902

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We received more and more feedback while improving the game. 
Reworked Night Shift mode (and fixing two little ghosts)
Fixed some rooms, new loading screen and some UI changes here and there! 
Music change correctly and now displays the name of the song.
Achievements work now perfectly and you just need to start the game to get all your unlocked ones.

Thank you everyone for your tremendous support!🥰👍
